description: A soft pack of cheap cigarettes. Each one shaves a little off your lungs and hands it to your image.

phases.comeup_message: You light up and draw deep. Your shoulders drop; the edge comes off your hunger.
phases.end_message: The cigarette burns down to the filter. The cool goes with it; the craving stays.
phases.peak_message: Nicotine hums through you. You feel, briefly, extremely cool and very slightly winded.

effects.take_line: You light a cigarette and draw on it.

withdrawal.message: Your hands keep going to a pocket that has nothing in it, and going again a minute later.

stages.easing: They find other things to do. Badly, and with resentment.
stages.onset: Your hands go looking for something and come back with nothing.
stages.peak: Your hands have gone to the pocket eleven times in the last hour and found it empty eleven times, and they are going again now.
stages.rising: They keep doing it. Pocket, mouth, pocket, and each time the whole way round before remembering.
stages.tail: They have stopped asking. They still go to the pocket about once an afternoon.

name: cigarettes
